services.imageAlt: Root canal treatment with digital X-ray and crown restoration at Gobigo Dental Care, Guduvancheri
services.title: Painless Root Canal Treatment (RCT) & Crowns
services.tamilTitle: வலி இல்லாத ரூட் கெனால் மற்றும் பற்கள் பொருத்துதல் (Root Canal & Crowns)
services.desc: Gentle rotary root canal treatment with digital intraoral X-rays to relieve severe toothache, eradicate infection, save natural teeth, and restore strength with precision aesthetic crowns.
services.longDesc: Advanced rotary endodontics and local anesthesia make modern root canal treatments virtually painless. We remove the inflamed dental pulp, disinfect the canals thoroughly, and reinforce the tooth with a lifelike, custom-milled dental crown.

services.imageAlt: Fixed crown and bridge tooth replacement rehabilitation at Gobigo Dental Care
services.title: Crowns, Fixed Bridges & Full Dentures
services.desc: Complete tooth replacement and rehabilitation options including fixed porcelain-fused-to-metal (PFM) and zirconia bridges, single crowns, and precision-fitted complete or partial dentures.
services.longDesc: Missing teeth impair chewing efficiency and affect jaw alignment. We create precision-milled dental bridges and comfortable lightweight dentures that fit securely, allowing you to eat, speak, and smile naturally.

services.imageAlt: CHESA electronic dental operatory suite at Gobigo Dental Care, Guduvanchery
services.title: Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery / Extractions
services.tamilTitle: பல் பிடுங்குதல் மற்றும் வாய் அறுவை சிகிச்சை (Surgical Extractions)
services.desc: Gentle tooth extractions, painless wisdom tooth surgical removal (impaction), corrective minor jaw procedures, and surgical care performed under strict sterile precautions.
services.longDesc: When teeth are severely impacted or non-restorable, our experienced surgeons perform gentle, atraumatic extractions minimizing post-operative swelling, tissue trauma, and discomfort.

services.imageAlt: Tooth reshaping and aesthetic contouring at Gobigo Dental Care
services.title: Cosmetic Dentistry & Tooth Reshaping
services.tamilTitle: புன்னகை வடிவமைப்பு மற்றும் பற்கள் அழகுபடுத்துதல் (Cosmetic & Reshaping)
services.desc: Aesthetic smile enhancements including tooth reshaping, enamel contouring, composite tooth-colored bonding, gap closures, chipped tooth repairs, and professional teeth whitening.
services.longDesc: Minor tooth imperfections like uneven edges, gaps, or chips can be corrected quickly and conservatively. We reshape and bond teeth with shade-matched composite resins for a harmonious, radiant smile.

services.imageAlt: Full arch teeth replacement and smile rehabilitation at Gobigo Dental Care
services.title: Full Mouth Smile Rehabilitation
services.tamilTitle: முழுமையான பல் மறுசீரமைப்பு சிகிச்சை (Full Mouth Rehabilitation)
services.desc: Comprehensive dental restorations for patients with multiple worn, damaged, or missing teeth, combining endodontic care, periodontal stabilization, and full arch prosthetic bridges.
services.longDesc: For complex cases involving worn enamel or multiple missing teeth, full mouth rehabilitation restores proper vertical dimension, chewing function, and facial aesthetics through coordinated multi-specialty care.

services.imageAlt: Teeth cleaning, scaling and dental filling at Gobigo Dental Care
services.title: Laser Dentistry, Scaling & Gum Therapy
services.tamilTitle: லேசர் பல் மருத்துவம் மற்றும் ஈறு சிகிச்சை (Laser & Gum Care)
services.desc: Advanced laser therapies for gum contouring and bleeding gums, paired with gentle ultrasonic teeth cleaning (scaling & polishing) to eliminate tartar, stains, and bad breath.
services.longDesc: Regular ultrasonic cleaning removes hardened calculus that brushing cannot reach, protecting against periodontal disease and tooth loss. Laser dental techniques ensure faster healing and minimal bleeding.

pageStory.sectionHeading: Compassionate Care, Clear Explanations & Modern Technology
paragraphs: Visiting the dentist should never be an intimidating experience. At Gobigo Dental Care in Guduvancheri, we have built a reputation on clinical gentleness, patient comfort, and thorough, easy-to-understand explanations before any procedure begins.

Equipped with advanced CHESA dental units, digital intraoral imaging, and modern restorative materials, our clinic provides end-to-end dental solutions under one roof — from single-sitting painless root canals and custom zirconia crowns to complete smile rehabilitations and pediatric dental care.

With a flawless 5.0★ rating on Google Maps from dozens of satisfied local families across Guduvancheri, Perumattunallur, Kayarambedu, and Nandivaram, our team remains committed to delivering honest, ethical, and pain-free dental healthcare seven days a week.

patientGuide.title: Helpful Tips Before & After Your Dental Visit

cards.title: Your First Dental Checkup
cards.desc: Arrive 5–10 minutes early. Our doctor conducts a gentle examination, takes digital intraoral X-rays if needed, and discusses your treatment plan with complete transparency.

cards.title: After Root Canal & Crown
cards.desc: Avoid chewing hard or sticky foods on the treated tooth until your permanent crown is cemented. Mild tenderness is normal for 24–48 hours and easily managed with prescribed medication.

cards.title: Denture & Bridge Maintenance
cards.desc: Clean removable dentures daily with a soft brush and non-abrasive cleanser. For fixed bridges, use superfloss or interdental brushes to keep the gumline healthy and fresh.

faqs.q: Where is Gobigo Dental Care located in Guduvancheri?
faqs.a: We are located at No. 24, Pragathi Enclave, Nellikuppam Road, Perumattunallur Main Road, right near Velammal School, Guduvancheri, Tamil Nadu 603202. Click our Google Maps directions button for direct GPS navigation.

faqs.q: What are the clinic timings of Gobigo Dental Care?
faqs.a: We are open Monday through Saturday with two daily sessions: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Morning) and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Evening). On Sundays, we are open from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM for weekend appointments.

faqs.q: Is root canal treatment (RCT) painful at Gobigo Dental Care?
faqs.a: No, root canal treatments at our clinic are gentle and virtually pain-free. Using modern local anesthesia, digital X-rays, and rotary endodontic equipment, our doctors ensure complete comfort while quickly relieving severe toothache.

faqs.q: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.a: You can call or WhatsApp our official clinic number directly at +91 84288 77818, or submit the appointment booking form on this website. Our clinic team confirms slots promptly.

faqs.q: What dental services and treatments do you provide?
faqs.a: We provide comprehensive dental treatments including Painless Root Canal Treatments (RCT), Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns, Fixed Bridges, Full & Partial Dentures, Tooth Extractions, Wisdom Tooth Surgery, Laser Dentistry, Tooth Reshaping, Cosmetic Bonding, Teeth Whitening, and Kids Dentistry.

faqs.q: Why is Gobigo Dental Care rated 5.0 stars on Google Maps?
faqs.a: Our 100% 5-star rating on Google Maps reflects our commitment to patient comfort, friendly doctors, patience in explaining every step, pleasant clinical ambience, and gentle, pain-free dental care.
